api_list.name: Get instagram media comments
api_list.description: Get instagram media comments by code
api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://instagram-fast.p.rapidapi.com/comments/ChN3La0oLYi"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "instagram-fast.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
